title: Help articles printed their updated date as plain text and sent no article:modified_time, so crawlers had no machine-readable freshness signal

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-metadata and seo-help finders). The article page rendered 'Updated 2026-09-20' as text in two places and its openGraph (type article) carried no publishedTime or modifiedTime, though the Article JSON-LD already publishes both dates. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the OG block sends publishedTime and modifiedTime (each guarded, since published is '' for a file without the key) and both visible dates are <time dateTime> elements.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/(help)/help/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx","utf8");if(!/modifiedTime: article\.updated/.test(s)||!/<time dateTime=\{article\.updated\}>/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-667: help articles print an updated date as plain text and send no article:modified_time, so crawlers get no machine-readable freshness signal for the help center.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
